# ===================================
# BRIDGE BACKEND - NO PYTHON REQUIRED
# ===================================
#
# This project uses SUPABASE as the backend (Backend-as-a-Service)
# There is NO Python backend to install or run.
#
# Backend Stack:
# - Database: PostgreSQL (hosted by Supabase)
# - Authentication: Supabase Auth
# - Real-time: Supabase Realtime
# - Storage: Supabase Storage
# - API: Auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs
#
# ===================================
# WHAT YOU NEED INSTEAD
# ===================================
#
# 1. Supabase Account (free tier available)
#    - Sign up at: https://supabase.com
#    - Create a new project
#    - Get your project URL and anon key
#
# 2. Environment Variables (.env file)
#    EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co
#    EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your_anon_key_here
#    SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=your_service_role_key_here
#
# 3. Supabase CLI (optional, for database migrations)
#    - Install: npm install -g supabase
#    - Or use: npx supabase <command>
#
# 4. Node.js Dependencies (for database scripts)
#    Already included in package.json:
#    - @supabase/supabase-js: ^2.81.1 (frontend client)
#    - pg: ^8.16.3 (PostgreSQL client for scripts)
#    - @types/pg: ^8.16.0 (TypeScript types)
#
# ===================================
# DATABASE SCRIPTS
# ===================================
#
# Run TypeScript scripts to manage your Supabase database:
#
# Test backend connection:
#   npx tsx scripts/test-backend-connection.ts
#
# Create test users:
#   npx tsx scripts/seed-test-users.ts
#
# Create development user:
#   npx tsx scripts/create-dev-user.ts
#
# Generate daily grids:
#   npx tsx scripts/generate-daily-grids-manual.ts
#
# Check test data:
#   npx tsx scripts/check-test-data.ts
#
# ===================================
# OPTIONAL: SUPABASE LOCAL DEVELOPMENT
# ===================================
#
# If you want to run Supabase locally (requires Docker):
#
# 1. Install Supabase CLI:
#    npm install -g supabase
#
# 2. Initialize Supabase (if not already done):
#    supabase init
#
# 3. Start local Supabase (requires Docker):
#    supabase start
#
# 4. Apply migrations:
#    supabase db reset
#
# 5. Stop local Supabase:
#    supabase stop
#
# ===================================
# PYTHON IS NOT USED
# ===================================
#
# This file exists because you requested a requirements.txt,
# but Bridge uses JavaScript/TypeScript + Supabase, not Python.
#
# If you need to add Python for specific tasks (data analysis,
# ML features, etc.), add dependencies below:
#
# Example Python dependencies (OPTIONAL, NOT CURRENTLY USED):
# python-dotenv==1.0.0
# supabase==2.3.0  # Python Supabase client
# pandas==2.1.4  # Data analysis
# numpy==1.26.3  # Numerical computing
